messages:
morgan: Heads up, we saw a handful of DB snapshot uploads from the backup-uploader service that are missing SSE headers. Not decryptable by Restore.
kevin: :eyes: How many and which tenants?
morgan: About 6 uploads in the last 12h across staging and prod-canary. Tenants A, D, and one internal test.
iris: Any pattern on how they were uploaded? direct presigned URLs vs service proxy?
morgan: Looks like a recent deploy changed the uploader to return presigned PUTs again for large snapshots. Those uploads go straight to the object store and the client doesn't set `x-amz-server-side-encryption` header, so the object ends up without SSE metadata.
sam: Oof. Did the presign flow include required header conditions?
morgan: No. The presign policy was simplified. Old flow had S3 condition "x-amz-server-side-encryption": "aws:kms" and a KMS Context check, new one removed it to fix a multi-part issue.
kevin: So KMS still sees content uploaded without SSE meta -> backups are stored unwrapped or just missing metadata?
morgan: They are stored unwrapped (SSE header missing). Objects exist but our restore path fails with decrypt errors when it expects CMK-wrapped objects.
iris: Can we re-wrap with CMK retroactively? Like copy-object with `x-amz-server-side-encryption` set?
sam: We could but need `kms:Encrypt` on the service account that performs the rewrap and also need to ensure encryption context matches. Also we must ensure tenants' CMK ACLs allow the rewrap principal.
encops-bot: Incident created: ENCOPS-2024-985. Initial severity: medium. Suggested actions: block presign endpoint, backfill detection, rewrap job.
kevin: Immediate plan: 1) Stop issuing presigned PUTs until policy is fixed. 2) Add a read-only detection run to list objects without SSE metadata. 3) If small count, perform copy->rewrite under uploader principal with SSE-KMS header.
iris: Agreed. Add guardrails: require `x-amz-server-side-encryption` in the presign conditions and enforce on upload proxy. Also require `kms:Encrypt` in the uploader role and ephemeral grants for rewrap.
morgan: For the rewrap job I'll need a service principal that has kms:Encrypt for the CMKs in scope. How do we avoid granting broad `kms:Encrypt` across tenants?
sam: Use per-tenant grant workflow: create ephemeral KMS grants with limited TTL for the rewrap job. Alternatively, have the tenant-use identity perform the copy if possible (but our presign bypasses that).
kevin: For immediate triage, can we fallback to the last-good snapshot during restore? We need a mitigation playbook if rewrap fails.
iris: Yes — restore can fallback to previous snapshot image. Ops should mark affected tenants and delay restores until rewrap finishes.
morgan: Audit log question: current audit logs show presign issuance and presigned PUTs but not the headers clients used. How can we detect header-less uploads reliably?
sam: Two signals: 1) S3/ObjectStore server-side metadata field `x-amz-server-side-encryption` missing in object metadata. 2) Our access logs for PUTs that include header presence — but object metadata check is most reliable.
kevin: Add a SIEM rule: if object created and SSE header missing AND path matches `/snapshots/` then alert and auto-tag object for rewrap queue.
iris: Also add an RBAC blocker: presign creation endpoint should require `uploader:presign:create` permission and only be enabled by a feature-flag. Backfill the flag to false.
morgan: Can we implement a quick policy patch? Example S3 presign condition snippet: ```json
{"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"x-amz-server-side-encryption":"aws:kms","x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id":"arn:aws:kms:...:key/CMK-XYZ"}}}
```
sam: That looks right. Also insist on `x-amz-server-side-encryption-context` if we use encryption context. Attach that to presign generation and verification at upload proxy.
kevin: Operational notes: - Put a short freeze on the presign deploy. - Run detection scan across last 24h. - If <100 objects, plan rewrap copy under uploader principal after ephemeral grant creation. - If >100, coordinate with tenant owners for roll-forward/rollback decisions.
iris: Post-mortem action items: 1) Add unit/integration test to ensure presigned policy contains SSE conditions. 2) Add CI check in deploy pipeline that flags presign logic changes. 3) Add alerting for missing SSE metadata on snapshot prefixes.
morgan: Who will own the rewrap job? I can own detection and small-scale rewraps, but need sam/infra to create ephemeral grants.
sam: I can do ephemeral grant automation and a one-off grant for the rewrap job. Will coordinate in the incident ticket.
kevin: Keep the incident channel updated. If any tenant had PII or regulated data, escalate to compliance.
iris: Quick Q: should we invalidate existing presigns and rotate uploader service account keys?
morgan: Invalidate presigns by toggling the feature flag; rotating keys feels heavy unless we detect compromise. For now don't rotate keys.
sam: I'll prepare the KMS grant script and post link in the ticket.
encops-bot: Update: mitigations in progress — presign endpoint disabled, detection scan scheduled, rewrap run queued (small set).
morgan: Thanks all. Will update when rewrap completes and attach list of affected objects.
kevin: :thumbsup:
